title: Tree Depth and Sample-Quality-Associated Features: Two Hidden Factors in Boruta Selection for RNA-Seq Data Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.33307v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Boruta is a widely used method for selecting gene panels from RNA sequencing data, and its most used implementation recommends Random Forest trees of depth 3 to 7, an untested setting. We tested whether this setting changes which genes are selected, using pan-cancer data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (10,469 tumors, 33 cancer types) and breast cancer PAM50 subtyping (981 tumors, 5 subtypes). A leakage-free protocol fitted every label-dependent step inside training folds, measured every effect against seed-to-seed variation, and held out a locked test set per task. In pan-cancer data, shallow trees changed the selection far more than a new seed did: the top-500 overlap with unlimited-depth selections was 0.37 at depth 5, against 0.84 to 0.93 between seeds at depth 5 or unlimited depth. Shallow trees confirmed 3.5 times fewer genes, missed markers of large classes and produced less accurate 50-gene panels (balanced accuracy 0.809 vs 0.889).

translated_title: 树深度与样本质量相关特征：RNA测序数据分类中Boruta特征选择的两个隐藏因素
translated_abstract: Boruta是一种广泛用于从RNA测序数据中筛选基因组合的方法，其最常用的实现推荐使用深度为3到7的随机森林树，但这一设置从未经过验证。我们利用癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）的泛癌数据（10,469例肿瘤，33种癌症类型）以及乳腺癌PAM50分型数据（981例肿瘤，5种亚型），检验了这一设置是否会改变被选中的基因。我们采用无信息泄漏的流程，在训练折内部拟合所有依赖标签的步骤，将每个效应与随机种子间的差异进行对比衡量，并为每个任务保留了一个锁定的测试集。在泛癌数据中，浅层树对基因选择的影响远大于更换随机种子：在深度为5时，与无限深度选择的top-500基因重叠度仅为0.37，而在深度为5或无限深度时，不同种子之间的重叠度为0.84至0.93。浅层树确认的基因数量减少了3.5倍，遗漏了大类别的标志物，且由此产生的50基因组合的分类准确性更低（平衡准确率0.809对0.889）。
tldr: 研究首次验证发现Boruta基因选择中默认推荐的浅层随机森林树深度是影响RNA测序数据分类结果的关键隐藏因素——浅层树导致的基因选择变化远超随机种子差异，会遗漏重要标志物并显著降低分类准确性。
en_tdlr: Tree depth in Boruta's recommended Random Forest settings is a hidden factor that substantially alters gene selection for RNA-seq classification, with shallow trees causing far more variation than random seeds, missing key markers, and yielding less accurate gene panels than unlimited-depth trees.
